newsitem.title: USA: Flows jump in US stock funds over 2 days - survey.
newsitem.headline: Flows jump in US stock funds over 2 days - survey.

text.p: Flows into U.S. stock funds surged to $342 million for the two days ended November 18, compared with $90 million for the previous three-day period, according to Mutual Fund Trim Tabs.
The fund tracking firm said international stock funds turned around to inflows of $53 million versus outflows of $49 million.

Aggressive growth funds posted outflows of $7 million versus inflows of $26 million, growth funds recorded inflows of $173 million versus outflows of $128 million, and growth and income funds had inflows of $174 million versus $116 million.

Bond funds recorded outflows of $64 million versus inflows of $50 million, the firm said. Outflows at government/GNMA funds narrowed to $9 million from $82 million, while muni fund outflows grew to $41 million from $1 million.
High yield funds posted outflows of $46 million versus inflows of $95 million.
